info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Accounts Receivable Management API
info.description: The Accounts Receivable Management API enables businesses to efficiently update and manage their accounts receivable data. This API allows users to adjust details related to specific accounts, ensuring accurate tracking of incoming payments and liabilities. Typical consumers include finance teams and accounting software integrations that require frequent updates to account statuses and payment records. Leverage this API to optimize cash flow management and streamline financial operations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific accounts receivable entry identified by the provided account number. Ensure accurate input to modify the account information effectively.

requestBody.description: Updates the details of the accounts receivable identified by ACC-200045. This request allows for partial updates to an existing account's information, ensuring that only the specified fields are modified.
